ply.definition:
n. one of the strands twisted together to make yarn or rope or thread; often used in combination
n. (usually in combinations) one of several layers of cloth or paper or wood as in plywood
v. apply oneself diligently
v. travel a route regularly
ply.translation:
n. 厚度, 板层
vt. 使用, 使劲挥舞, 从事, 折, 弯
vi. 辛勤工作, 定期航行

ply sb with sth.translation: 不断地提供, 不断提出问题

plyboard.definition: n. a laminate made of thin layers of wood

plymouth.definition: n. a town in Massachusetts founded by Pilgrims in 1620
plymouth.translation: n. 普利茅斯（英国一座城市）

plymouth brethren.definition:
The members of a religious sect which first
   appeared at Plymouth, England, about 1830. They protest against
   sectarianism, and reject all official ministry or clergy. Also called
   Brethren, Christian Brethren, Plymouthists, etc. The Darbyites are a
   division of the Brethren.

plymouth colony.translation: [网络] 普利茅斯殖民地；普利茅斯植民地；普里茅斯殖民地

plymouth rock.translation:
